tools.name: telegram_mtproto__list_connectors
tools.description: List WhatsApp, Instagram, Email, X connector status for a support agent.

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__suggest_targets
tools.description: AI-propose Instagram or X @targets for a discovery scan (depth/breadth optional).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__run_scan
tools.description: Start a leads discovery scan (whatsapp, instagram, x, or telegram).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__continue_scan
tools.description: Continue a scan paused for selection (WhatsApp/Telegram groups or IG/X targets).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__list_scans
tools.description: List past and active leads discovery scans for an agent.

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__get_scan
tools.description: Get one scan with paginated leads (status, progress, leads).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__list_scan_results
tools.description: Alias of get_scan — read leads from an active or completed scan.

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__delete_scans
tools.description: Delete one or more completed scan runs (does not delete schedules).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__import_leads
tools.description: Import discovered leads into the agent CRM (outreach: none|immediate|bulk_followup).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__clear_discovery_cache
tools.description: Clear Leads Discovery scan cache for an agent (seen handles / WA progress).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__create_scan_schedule
tools.description: Create an auto-scan schedule (Import Only or Message now outreach).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__list_scan_schedules
tools.description: List auto-scan schedules for an agent.

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__update_scan_schedule
tools.description: Update or pause/resume an auto-scan schedule.

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__trigger_scan_schedule
tools.description: Run an auto-scan schedule immediately (Run now).

tools.name: telegram_mtproto__get_discovery_analytics
tools.description: Get sourced-leads analytics for an agent (window e.g. 7d, 30d).

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "telegram-agent" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: telegram_mtproto__list_connectors · Public sink: telegram_mtproto__list_connectors · Destructive: telegram_mtproto__run_scan, telegram_mtproto__delete_scans, telegram_mtproto__delete_scan_schedule, telegram_mtproto__trigger_scan_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: telegram_mtproto__list_connectors · Public sink: telegram_mtproto__list_connectors · Destructive: telegram_mtproto__run_scan, telegram_mtproto__delete_scans, telegram_mtproto__delete_scan_schedule, telegram_mtproto__trigger_scan_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
